subject: 🏃 Wednesday — Heavy Strength (Wk 1)
html:
Tomorrow: Heavy Strength — W1 Calibration (Cañada College)

This is the first heavy session of the V6 plan. The goal is calibration, not performance — find the working weight that feels Good (2–3 reps in reserve) with a clean 3-second eccentric on every rep. Whatever you land on becomes the baseline for the next 6 weeks.

Warm-up: Foam roll quads & IT band (1 min each) → glute bridges (10 reps) → hip CARs (3 each direction, each leg) → bodyweight squats (10 reps) → RDL pattern with empty bar (10 reps).

Session (3–4 sets × 6–8 reps, 3-sec eccentric):

ExerciseWeightSets × RepsCue
Back SquatRamp: 45×10, 95×5, 115×5, then build to ~135 lb3–4 × 6–83-sec eccentric, knees track over toes
Romanian DeadliftSame ramp, target ~155 lb3–4 × 6–8Hinge pattern, neutral spine, hamstring stretch
Reverse NordicBodyweight3 × 8Knees together, 3-sec lower, quad eccentric
Standing Calf Raise30 lb/hand DBs3 × 10Full ROM, 2-sec hold at top

Focus cue: On every squat and RDL rep, count "one-thousand-one, one-thousand-two, one-thousand-three" on the way down. If you can't hold the 3-sec eccentric, the weight is too heavy — drop 10 lb and own the tempo.

Context: Week 1 of 12, Phase 1 Foundation & Durability — 81 days to race day. Knee has been 1/5 through all ramp-up runs and today's track session (8.39 mi, max HR 190). You're entering the strength block with a perfectly clean knee, which is exactly what we wanted before loading it under a bar.

Prep tonight: Lay out gym clothes and pack your belt if you use one. Get to bed by 10. A banana and coffee 30 min before is plenty for a lifting day — no need for a big meal.
